newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: TIBS Holdings sets up China automotive JV.
newsitem.headline: TIBS Holdings sets up China automotive JV.

text.p: TIBS Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had set up a joint venture company with a Chinese partner to develop automotive parts and related operations.

TIBS China Automotive Industries Investment Pte Ltd (TIBS China) said in a statement it had signed a deal with Dandong Automobile Works (DAW) under which each would hold a 50 percent stake in the joint venture company.
The new firm, Huanghai Automotive Industries Ltd, would have a registered capital of US$36 million and a total investment value of US$75.6 million, it said.

TIBS said its investment of US$18 million in cash was expected to be financed from internal fundings and external borrowings while DAW's US$18 million share would be in infrastructure, technology and other contributions.
The company was expected to be operational after a business licence is granted, it said.
TIBS said the contract was not expected to have any material effect on its net tangible asset and earnings per share for the current financial year ending December 31, 1997.
